  563 |     def clear_all_spills(self) -> None:
  564 |         """
  565 |         Purges all active spills and re-initializes pristine table state.
  566 |         """
  567 |         with self._get_connection() as conn:
  568 |             cursor = conn.cursor()
  569 |             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM oil_spills")
  570 |             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM drift_simulations")
  571 |             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM vessel_attributions")
  572 |             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM optical_confirmations")
  573 |             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM thickness_estimates")
  574 |             cursor.execute("DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS prevent_evidence_ledger_delete")
  575 |             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM evidence_ledger")
  576 |             cursor.execute("""
  577 |                 CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS prevent_evidence_ledger_delete
  578 |                 BEFORE DELETE ON evidence_ledger
  579 |                 BEGIN
  580 |                     SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'evidence_ledger is an immutable append-only ledger; DELETE operations are forbidden at database level.');
  581 |                 END;
  582 |             """)
  583 |             conn.commit()

  585 |     def get_statistics(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  586 |         """
  587 |         Calculates aggregate metrics for the dashboard.
  588 |         """
  589 |         with self._get_connection() as conn:
  590 |             cursor = conn.cursor()
  591 |             cursor.execute("""
  592 |                 SELECT 
  593 |                     COUNT(*) as total_spills,
  594 |                     COALESCE(SUM(area_km2), 0) as total_area_km2,
  595 |                     COALESCE(AVG(confidence), 0) as avg_confidence,
  596 |                     COALESCE(MAX(area_km2), 0) as max_spill_area_km2,
  597 |                     COALESCE(AVG(length_km), 0) as avg_length_km
  598 |                 FROM oil_spills
  599 |             """)
  600 |             summary = dict(cursor.fetchone())
  601 |             
  602 |             # Confidence brackets
  603 |             cursor.execute("""
  604 |                 SELECT 
  605 |                     CASE 
  606 |                         WHEN confidence >= 0.85 THEN 'High (>= 85%)'
  607 |                         WHEN confidence >= 0.70 THEN 'Medium (70-84%)'
  608 |                         ELSE 'Low (< 70%)'
  609 |                     END as bracket,
  610 |                     COUNT(*) as count
  611 |                 FROM oil_spills
  612 |                 GROUP BY bracket
  613 |             """)
  614 |             confidence_dist = [dict(r) for r in cursor.fetchall()]
  615 | 
  616 |             # Area brackets
  617 |             cursor.execute("""
  618 |                 SELECT 
  619 |                     CASE 
  620 |                         WHEN area_km2 < 1.0 THEN '< 1.0 km²'
  621 |                         WHEN area_km2 < 5.0 THEN '1.0 - 5.0 km²'
  622 |                         WHEN area_km2 < 15.0 THEN '5.0 - 15.0 km²'
  623 |                         ELSE '> 15.0 km²'
  624 |                     END as size_category,
  625 |                     COUNT(*) as count
  626 |                 FROM oil_spills
  627 |                 GROUP BY size_category
  628 |             """)
  629 |             area_dist = [dict(r) for r in cursor.fetchall()]
  630 | 
  631 |             return {
  632 |                 "summary": summary,
  633 |                 "confidence_distribution": confidence_dist,
  634 |                 "area_distribution": area_dist
  635 |             }

  840 |     def get_assembled_spill(self, spill_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
  841 |         """
  842 |         Assembles all pipeline stages (Detection, Drift, Vessel, Optical Fusion,
  843 |         SAR Thickness) for a spill ID and evaluates Phase 7 Evidence Ledger verification.
  844 |         """
  845 |         spill = self.get_spill_by_id(spill_id)
  846 |         if not spill:
  847 |             return None
  848 | 
  849 |         drift     = self.get_drift_simulation(spill_id)
  850 |         vessels   = self.get_vessel_correlation(spill_id)
  851 |         optical   = self.get_optical_confirmation(spill_id)
  852 |         thickness = self.get_thickness_estimate(spill_id)
  853 | 
  854 |         # Lazy import evidence_service to verify tamper-evident chain
  855 |         from app.services.evidence_service import evidence_service
  856 |         verification = evidence_service.verify_chain(spill_id)
  857 |         is_chain_verified = verification.chain_verified and verification.chain_length > 0
  858 |         provenance_status = "VERIFIED" if is_chain_verified else "ASSEMBLED"
  859 | 
  860 |         import datetime
  861 |         now_utc = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
  862 | 
  863 |         return {
  864 |             "spill_id": spill_id,
  865 |             "assembled_at": now_utc,
  866 |             "provenance": provenance_status,
  867 |             "provenance_registry": {
  868 |                 "detection": "DETECTED",
  869 |                 "environmental_currents_wind": "MEASURED",
  870 |                 "drift_hindcast_forecast": "MODEL-PREDICTED",
  871 |                 "vessel_anomaly_attribution": "ANOMALY-FLAGGED",
  872 |                 "optical_fusion": "MEASURED",
  873 |                 "sar_thickness": "MODEL-PREDICTED",
  874 |                 "evidence_ledger": "VERIFIED" if is_chain_verified else "UNVERIFIED"
  875 |             },
  876 |             "evidence_summary": {
  877 |                 "chain_verified": is_chain_verified,
  878 |                 "chain_length": verification.chain_length,
  879 |                 "merkle_root": verification.merkle_root,
  880 |                 "provenance": provenance_status,
  881 |                 "stages_covered": verification.stages_covered,
  882 |                 "public_anchor": verification.public_anchor.model_dump()
  883 |             },
  884 |             "spill": spill.model_dump() if hasattr(spill, "model_dump") else spill,
  885 |             "drift": drift,
  886 |             "vessels": vessels,
  887 |             "optical": optical,
  888 |             "sar_thickness": thickness,
  889 |             "stats": {
  890 |                 "area_km2": spill.area_km2,
  891 |                 "confidence": spill.confidence,
  892 |                 "has_drift_simulated": drift is not None,
  893 |                 "has_vessels_correlated": vessels is not None,
  894 |                 "has_optical_confirmed": optical.get("optical_confirmed") is True if optical else False,
  895 |                 "optical_status": (
  896 |                     "CONFIRMED" if optical and optical.get("optical_confirmed") is True
  897 |                     else ("UNCONFIRMED" if optical and optical.get("optical_confirmed") is False
  898 |                     else ("NO_CLEAN_SCENE" if optical and optical.get("optical_confirmed") is None
  899 |                     else "NOT_EVALUATED"))
  900 |                 ),
  901 |                 "sar_thickness_classification": thickness.get("classification") if thickness else None,
  902 |                 "sar_thickness_cross_validated": thickness.get("cross_validated_with_optical") if thickness else None,
  903 |                 "total_candidates": len(vessels.get("candidate_vessels", [])) if vessels else 0,
  904 |                 "evidence_chain_verified": is_chain_verified
  905 |             }
  906 |         }

  912 |     def create_monitor(self, monitor_data: AOIMonitorCreate) -> AOIMonitorRecord:
  913 |         """
  914 |         Creates and stores a new AOI Monitor in the database.
  915 |         """
  916 |         monitor_id = f"mon-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}"
  917 |         now_str = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
  918 | 
  919 |         with self._get_connection() as conn:

 1158 |     def get_external_incidents(
 1159 |         self,
 1160 |         bbox: Optional[List[float]] = None,
 1161 |         start_date: Optional[str] = None,
 1162 |         end_date: Optional[str] = None,
 1163 |         limit: int = 100
 1164 |     ) -> List[ExternalIncident]:
 1165 |         """
 1166 |         Queries external ground-truth incidents with optional spatial bounding box and date filters.
 1167 |         """
 1168 |         with self._get_connection() as conn:
 1169 |             cursor = conn.cursor()
 1170 |             query = "SELECT * FROM external_incidents WHERE 1=1"
 1171 |             params: List[Any] = []
 1172 | 
 1173 |             if start_date:
 1174 |                 query += " AND reported_at >= ?"
 1175 |                 params.append(start_date)
 1176 |             if end_date:
 1177 |                 query += " AND reported_at <= ?"
 1178 |                 params.append(end_date)
 1179 | 
 1180 |             query += " ORDER BY reported_at DESC"
 1181 | 
 1182 |             cursor.execute(query, params)
 1183 |             rows = cursor.fetchall()
 1184 | 
 1185 |             results: List[ExternalIncident] = []
 1186 |             aoi_poly = None
 1187 |             if bbox and len(bbox) == 4:
 1188 |                 min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat = bbox
 1189 |                 aoi_poly = Polygon([
 1190 |                     (min_lon, min_lat),
 1191 |                     (max_lon, min_lat),
 1192 |                     (max_lon, max_lat),
 1193 |                     (min_lon, max_lat),
 1194 |                     (min_lon, min_lat)
 1195 |                 ])
 1196 | 
 1197 |             for row in rows:
 1198 |                 record = self._row_to_external_incident(row)
 1199 |                 if aoi_poly:
 1200 |                     # Check if incident geometry intersects AOI or centroid is within AOI
 1201 |                     rec_geom = shape(record.geometry)
 1202 |                     rec_centroid = Point(record.centroid[0], record.centroid[1])
 1203 |                     if not (rec_geom.intersects(aoi_poly) or aoi_poly.contains(rec_centroid)):
 1204 |                         continue
 1205 |                 results.append(record)
 1206 |                 if len(results) >= limit:
 1207 |                     break
 1208 | 
 1209 |             return results

 1332 |     def insert_ais_pings_batch(self, pings: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
 1333 |         """
 1334 |         Inserts a batch of authentic AIS telemetry pings into SQLite.
 1335 |         """
 1336 |         if not pings:
 1337 |             return 0
 1338 |         records = []
 1339 |         for p in pings:
 1340 |             records.append((
 1341 |                 str(p.get("mmsi", "")).strip(),
 1342 |                 p.get("vessel_name") or p.get("name"),
 1343 |                 p.get("ship_type") or p.get("vessel_type") or "Unknown",
 1344 |                 p.get("flag", "International"),
 1345 |                 str(p.get("imo", "")) if p.get("imo") else None,
 1346 |                 float(p.get("length_m", 0.0) or 0.0),
 1347 |                 float(p.get("deadweight_tonnage", 0.0) or 0.0) if p.get("deadweight_tonnage") else None,
 1348 |                 float(p["lon"]),
 1349 |                 float(p["lat"]),
 1350 |                 float(p.get("sog", 0.0) or 0.0),
 1351 |                 float(p.get("cog", 0.0) or 0.0),
 1352 |                 float(p.get("heading", 0.0) or 0.0) if p.get("heading") is not None else None,
 1353 |                 str(p["timestamp"]),
 1354 |                 p.get("source", "LIVE_STREAM")
 1355 |             ))
 1356 |         with self._get_connection() as conn:
 1357 |             cursor = conn.cursor()
 1358 |             cursor.executemany("""
 1359 |                 INSERT INTO historical_ais_pings (
 1360 |                     mmsi, vessel_name, ship_type, flag, imo, length_m,
 1361 |                     deadweight_tonnage, lon, lat, sog, cog, heading,
 1362 |                     timestamp, source
 1363 |                 ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
 1364 |             """, records)
 1365 |             conn.commit()
 1366 |             return len(records)

 1368 |     def query_historical_ais_tracks(
 1369 |         self,
 1370 |         bbox: List[float],
 1371 |         start_time_iso: str,
 1372 |         end_time_iso: str
 1373 |     ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
 1374 |         """
 1375 |         Queries authentic historical AIS pings within the spatial-temporal envelope [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat]
 1376 |         and aggregates them into chronologically ordered vessel track records.
 1377 |         """
 1378 |         min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat = bbox[0], bbox[1], bbox[2], bbox[3]
 1379 |         with self._get_connection() as conn:
 1380 |             cursor = conn.cursor()
 1381 |             cursor.execute("""
 1382 |                 SELECT mmsi, vessel_name, ship_type, flag, imo, length_m,
 1383 |                        deadweight_tonnage, lon, lat, sog, cog, heading, timestamp, source
 1384 |                 FROM historical_ais_pings
 1385 |                 WHERE lon >= ? AND lon <= ?
 1386 |                   AND lat >= ? AND lat <= ?
 1387 |                   AND timestamp >= ? AND timestamp <= ?
 1388 |                 ORDER BY mmsi, timestamp ASC
 1389 |             """, (min_lon, max_lon, min_lat, max_lat, start_time_iso, end_time_iso))
 1390 |             rows = cursor.fetchall()
 1391 | 
 1392 |         # Group by MMSI
 1393 |         vessels_map: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
 1394 |         from app.schemas.vessel import VesselPoint
 1395 | 
 1396 |         for r in rows:
 1397 |             mmsi = r["mmsi"]
 1398 |             if mmsi not in vessels_map:
 1399 |                 vessels_map[mmsi] = {
 1400 |                     "mmsi": mmsi,
 1401 |                     "vessel_name": r["vessel_name"] or f"VESSEL-{mmsi}",
 1402 |                     "vessel_type": r["ship_type"] or "Vessel",
 1403 |                     "flag": r["flag"] or "International",
 1404 |                     "imo": r["imo"],
 1405 |                     "length_m": r["length_m"] or 150.0,
 1406 |                     "deadweight_tonnage": r["deadweight_tonnage"] or 35000.0,
 1407 |                     "track": [],
 1408 |                     "has_deliberate_gap": False,
 1409 |                     "is_ais_dark": False,
 1410 |                     "provenance": "MEASURED_HISTORICAL_AIS",
 1411 |                     "data_source": r["source"] or "HISTORICAL_ARCHIVE",
 1412 |                     "is_authentic_real": True
 1413 |                 }
 1414 | 
 1415 |             vessels_map[mmsi]["track"].append(VesselPoint(
 1416 |                 lon=float(r["lon"]),
 1417 |                 lat=float(r["lat"]),
 1418 |                 sog_knots=float(r["sog"] or 0.0),
 1419 |                 cog_deg=float(r["cog"] or 0.0),
 1420 |                 heading_deg=float(r["heading"]) if r["heading"] is not None else float(r["cog"] or 0.0),
 1421 |                 timestamp=r["timestamp"],
 1422 |                 is_gap_interpolated=False
 1423 |             ))
 1424 | 
 1425 |         # Check for AIS dark gaps in each authentic track
 1426 |         results = []
 1427 |         for mmsi, vdata in vessels_map.items():
 1428 |             pts = vdata["track"]
 1429 |             if len(pts) >= 2:
 1430 |                 # Check for > 1.5h time gap between consecutive pings
 1431 |                 has_gap = False
 1432 |                 for i in range(1, len(pts)):
 1433 |                     try:
 1434 |                         t1 = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(pts[i-1].timestamp.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
 1435 |                         t2 = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(pts[i].timestamp.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
 1436 |                         if (t2 - t1).total_seconds() > 5400: # 1.5 hours
 1437 |                             has_gap = True
 1438 |                             pts[i].is_gap_interpolated = True
 1439 |                     except Exception:
 1440 |                         pass
 1441 |                 vdata["has_deliberate_gap"] = has_gap
 1442 |                 vdata["is_ais_dark"] = has_gap
 1443 |             results.append(vdata)
 1444 | 
 1445 |         return results
 1446 | 
 1447 |     def get_ais_table_stats(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
 1448 |         """

  129 | class ExternalIncidentService:
  130 |     """
  131 |     Ingests and normalizes external ground-truth oil spill reference records strictly
  132 |     for pipeline validation and benchmarking.
  133 |     """
  134 | 
  135 |     @staticmethod
  136 |     def normalize_incident_record(data: Dict[str, Any], default_source: str = "External Ground Truth") -> ExternalIncident:
  137 |         """
  138 |         Parses raw dict/GeoJSON object into a strictly validated ExternalIncident with centroid, bbox,
  139 |         and 'EXTERNAL-REFERENCE' provenance.
  140 |         """
  141 |         incident_id = data.get("incident_id") or f"ext-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}"
  142 |         source_name = data.get("source_name") or default_source
  143 |         reported_at = data.get("reported_at") or data.get("timestamp") or "2023-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  144 |         geom_dict = data.get("geometry")
  145 | 
  146 |         if not geom_dict:
  147 |             # Fallback if lon/lat provided directly
  148 |             lon = float(data.get("lon") or data.get("longitude") or 0.0)
  149 |             lat = float(data.get("lat") or data.get("latitude") or 0.0)
  150 |             geom_dict = {
  151 |                 "type": "Point",
  152 |                 "coordinates": [lon, lat]
  153 |             }
  154 | 
  155 |         geom_obj = shape(geom_dict)
  156 |         centroid_point = geom_obj.centroid
  157 |         centroid = [round(centroid_point.x, 6), round(centroid_point.y, 6)]
  158 |         
  159 |         bounds = geom_obj.bounds # (minx, miny, maxx, maxy)
  160 |         if bounds[0] == bounds[2] and bounds[1] == bounds[3]:
  161 |             # Point buffer for bbox representation
  162 |             bbox = [bounds[0] - 0.01, bounds[1] - 0.01, bounds[0] + 0.01, bounds[1] + 0.01]
  163 |         else:
  164 |             bbox = [round(b, 6) for b in bounds]
  165 | 
  166 |         area_km2 = data.get("estimated_area_km2") or data.get("area_km2")
  167 |         if area_km2 is None and geom_obj.geom_type in ["Polygon", "MultiPolygon"]:
  168 |             # Approximate rough sq km from degrees at centroid latitude (1 deg lat ~ 111 km)
  169 |             import math
  170 |             lat_rad = math.radians(centroid[1])
  171 |             sq_deg = geom_obj.area
  172 |             area_km2 = round(sq_deg * 111.0 * (111.0 * math.cos(lat_rad)), 2)
  173 | 
  174 |         return ExternalIncident(
  175 |             incident_id=incident_id,
  176 |             source_name=source_name,
  177 |             reported_at=reported_at,
  178 |             geometry=geom_dict,
  179 |             centroid=centroid,
  180 |             bbox=bbox,
  181 |             estimated_area_km2=float(area_km2) if area_km2 is not None else None,
  182 |             confidence_or_score=float(data["confidence_or_score"]) if data.get("confidence_or_score") is not None else None,
  183 |             source_url=data.get("source_url"),
  184 |             notes_or_vessel=data.get("notes_or_vessel") or data.get("notes") or data.get("vessel_name"),
  185 |             provenance="EXTERNAL-REFERENCE"
  186 |         )
  187 | 
  188 |     @classmethod
  189 |     def get_seed_incidents(cls) -> List[ExternalIncident]:
  190 |         """
  191 |         Returns normalized list of curated ground-truth reference incidents.
  192 |         """
  193 |         results = []
  194 |         for inc in CURATED_REFERENCE_INCIDENTS:
  195 |             results.append(cls.normalize_incident_record(inc, default_source=inc.get("source_name", "SkyTruth Cerulean")))
  196 |         return results
  197 | 
  198 |     @classmethod
  199 |     def parse_geojson_feature_collection(cls, geojson_data: Dict[str, Any], default_source: str = "GeoJSON Import") -> List[ExternalIncident]:
  200 |         """
  201 |         Parses standard GeoJSON FeatureCollection into list of normalized ExternalIncidents.
  202 |         """
  203 |         incidents = []
  204 |         features = geojson_data.get("features", [])
  205 |         for feat in features:
  206 |             props = feat.get("properties", {})
  207 |             geom = feat.get("geometry")
  208 |             if not geom:
  209 |                 continue
  210 |             
  211 |             rec_dict = {
  212 |                 "incident_id": props.get("id") or props.get("incident_id") or feat.get("id"),
  213 |                 "source_name": props.get("source") or props.get("source_name") or default_source,
  214 |                 "reported_at": props.get("reported_at") or props.get("time") or props.get("date"),
  215 |                 "geometry": geom,
  216 |                 "estimated_area_km2": props.get("area_km2") or props.get("area"),
  217 |                 "confidence_or_score": props.get("confidence") or props.get("score"),
  218 |                 "source_url": props.get("url") or props.get("source_url"),
  219 |                 "notes_or_vessel": props.get("vessel") or props.get("notes") or props.get("description")
  220 |             }
  221 |             incidents.append(cls.normalize_incident_record(rec_dict, default_source=default_source))
  222 |         return incidents

   16 | class GEEAuthService:
   17 |     """
   18 |     Manages Google Earth Engine authentication.
   19 |     Supports:
   20 |     1. Service Account authentication (for non-interactive background/scheduled jobs)
   21 |        via GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL and GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH (or EE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_*).
   22 |     2. User/Interactive credentials fallback for local development.
   23 |     3. Graceful degradation to high-fidelity SAR GeoEngine simulation if unauthenticated.
   24 |     """
   25 | 
   26 |     def __init__(self):
   27 |         self.initialized = False
   28 |         self.auth_mode: str = "UNINITIALIZED"
   29 |         self.service_account_email: Optional[str] = None
   30 |         self.project_id: Optional[str] = None
   31 |         self.init_error: Optional[str] = None
   32 |         self.initialize()
   33 | 
   34 |     def initialize(self) -> bool:
   35 |         """
   36 |         Attempts to initialize Earth Engine with the highest priority authentication path available.
   37 |         """
   38 |         if not EE_AVAILABLE or os.getenv("TESTING") == "1":
   39 |             self.auth_mode = "SIMULATION" if os.getenv("TESTING") == "1" else "SIMULATION_NO_EE_LIB"
   40 |             self.initialized = False
   41 |             return False
   42 | 
   43 |         # Load environment configuration
   44 |         sa_email = (
   45 |             os.getenv("GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL")
   46 |             or os.getenv("EE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL")
   47 |         )
   48 |         sa_key_path = (
   49 |             os.getenv("GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH")
   50 |             or os.getenv("EE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_PATH")
   51 |             or os.getenv("EE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON")
   52 |         )
   53 |         project_id = (
   54 |             os.getenv("EE_PROJECT_ID")
   55 |             or os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
   56 |             or os.getenv("GCP_PROJECT")
   57 |         )
   58 | 
   59 |         self.project_id = project_id
   60 |         self.service_account_email = sa_email
   61 | 
   62 |         # ─── PATH 1: Service Account Authentication ───────────────────────────
   63 |         if sa_email and sa_key_path:
   64 |             try:
   65 |                 if os.path.isfile(sa_key_path):
   66 |                     logger.info(f"Authenticating GEE via Service Account key file: {sa_key_path} for {sa_email}...")
   67 |                     credentials = ee.ServiceAccountCredentials(sa_email, key_file=sa_key_path)
   68 |                 elif sa_key_path.strip().startswith("{"):
   69 |                     logger.info(f"Authenticating GEE via inline Service Account JSON for {sa_email}...")
   70 |                     key_data = json.loads(sa_key_path)
   71 |                     credentials = ee.ServiceAccountCredentials(sa_email, key_data=key_data)
   72 |                 else:
   73 |                     raise FileNotFoundError(f"Service account key path does not exist: {sa_key_path}")
   74 | 
   75 |                 if project_id:
   76 |                     ee.Initialize(credentials, project=project_id)
   77 |                 else:
   78 |                     ee.Initialize(credentials)
   79 | 
   80 |                 self.initialized = True
   81 |                 self.auth_mode = "SERVICE_ACCOUNT"
   82 |                 self.init_error = None
   83 |                 logger.info(f"✓ GEE Service Account Auth SUCCEEDED for {sa_email} (Project: {project_id or 'default'}).")
   84 |                 return True
   85 |             except Exception as e:
   86 |                 self.init_error = str(e)
   87 |                 logger.error(f"✗ GEE Service Account Auth FAILED: {e}. Attempting user auth fallback...", exc_info=True)
   88 | 
   89 |         # ─── PATH 2: Standard User / Interactive Auth Fallback ─────────────────
   90 |         try:
   91 |             if project_id:
   92 |                 ee.Initialize(project=project_id)
   93 |             else:
   94 |                 ee.Initialize()
   95 | 
   96 |             self.initialized = True
   97 |             self.auth_mode = "USER_CREDENTIALS"
   98 |             self.init_error = None
   99 |             logger.info(f"✓ GEE User Credentials Auth SUCCEEDED (Project: {project_id or 'default'}).")
  100 |             return True
  101 |         except Exception as e:
  102 |             self.initialized = False
  103 |             self.auth_mode = "SIMULATION"
  104 |             self.init_error = str(e)
  105 |             logger.warning(
  106 |                 f"GEE authentication not available ({e}). Live pipelines will utilize High-Fidelity SAR GeoEngine simulation."
  107 |             )
  108 |             return False
  109 | 
  110 |     def get_status(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  111 |         """
  112 |         Returns structured health & auth metadata.
  113 |         """
  114 |         return {
  115 |             "initialized": self.initialized,
  116 |             "auth_mode": self.auth_mode,
  117 |             "project_id": self.project_id,
  118 |             "service_account_email": self.service_account_email,
  119 |             "error": self.init_error,
  120 |             "ee_library_available": EE_AVAILABLE,
  121 |         }

   28 | class LiveAlertsConnectionManager:
   29 |     """
   30 |     Manages active WebSocket connections for live alert broadcasting.
   31 |     """
   32 |     def __init__(self):
   33 |         self.active_connections: Set[WebSocket] = set()
   34 |         self.recent_alerts: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
   35 | 
   36 |     async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket):
   37 |         await websocket.accept()
   38 |         self.active_connections.add(websocket)
   39 |         logger.info(f"Live Alert WebSocket connected. Total active: {len(self.active_connections)}")
   40 | 
   41 |     def disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket):
   42 |         self.active_connections.discard(websocket)
   43 |         logger.info(f"Live Alert WebSocket disconnected. Total active: {len(self.active_connections)}")
   44 | 
   45 |     async def broadcast(self, message: Dict[str, Any]):
   46 |         self.recent_alerts.insert(0, message)
   47 |         if len(self.recent_alerts) > 50:
   48 |             self.recent_alerts = self.recent_alerts[:50]
   49 | 
   50 |         dead_connections = set()
   51 |         for conn in self.active_connections:
   52 |             try:
   53 |                 await conn.send_json(message)
   54 |             except Exception as e:
   55 |                 logger.warning(f"Error sending to live alert websocket: {e}")
   56 |                 dead_connections.add(conn)
   57 | 
   58 |         for dead in dead_connections:
   59 |             self.active_connections.discard(dead)
   60 | 
   61 |     def get_recent_alerts(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
   62 |         return self.recent_alerts

   68 | class LiveSchedulerService:
   69 |     """
   70 |     Background polling scheduler that monitors defined AOIs for newly ingested
   71 |     Sentinel-1 SAR imagery, automatically triggers detection, executes optical
   72 |     cross-check, and dispatches real-time WebSocket alerts to dashboard clients.
   73 |     """
   74 | 
   75 |     def __init__(self):

   77 |         self.sar_engine = SAREngine()
   78 |         self.optical_service = OpticalFusionService()
   79 |         self.thickness_service = SARThicknessService()
   80 |         self.is_running = False
   81 | 
   82 |     def start(self):
   83 |         """
   84 |         Initializes and starts the APScheduler background loop.
   85 |         """
   86 |         if self.is_running:
   87 |             return
   88 | 
   89 |         try:
   90 |             self.scheduler.start()
   91 |             self.is_running = True
   92 |             logger.info("Live Detection Scheduler started.")
   93 |             self._sync_all_monitor_jobs()
   94 |         except Exception as e:
   95 |             logger.error(f"Failed to start Live Detection Scheduler: {e}")
   96 | 
   97 |     def shutdown(self):
   98 |         """
   99 |         Gracefully stops the background scheduler.
  100 |         """
  101 |         if self.is_running:
  102 |             self.scheduler.shutdown(wait=False)
  103 |             self.is_running = False
  104 |             logger.info("Live Detection Scheduler stopped.")
  105 | 
  106 |     def _sync_all_monitor_jobs(self):
  107 |         """
  108 |         Synchronizes all active AOI monitor records with scheduler jobs.
  109 |         """
  110 |         monitors = db_service.get_monitors(active_only=True)
  111 |         for mon in monitors:
  112 |             self.reschedule_monitor(mon.id, mon.poll_interval_hours)
  113 | 
  114 |     def reschedule_monitor(self, monitor_id: str, interval_hours: int = 6):
  115 |         """
  116 |         Adds or updates a periodic polling job for a specific monitor.
  117 |         """
  118 |         job_id = f"job_{monitor_id}"
  119 |         if self.scheduler.get_job(job_id):
  120 |             self.scheduler.remove_job(job_id)
  121 | 
  122 |         self.scheduler.add_job(
  123 |             self.poll_aoi_monitor,
  124 |             trigger=IntervalTrigger(hours=max(1, interval_hours)),
  125 |             id=job_id,
  126 |             args=[monitor_id],
  127 |             replace_existing=True,
  128 |             misfire_grace_time=3600
  129 |         )
  130 |         logger.info(f"Scheduled periodic live polling for monitor [{monitor_id}] every {interval_hours}h.")
  131 | 
  132 |     def remove_monitor_job(self, monitor_id: str):
  133 |         """
  134 |         Removes the scheduled job when an AOI monitor is deactivated or deleted.
  135 |         """
  136 |         job_id = f"job_{monitor_id}"
  137 |         if self.scheduler.get_job(job_id):
  138 |             self.scheduler.remove_job(job_id)
  139 |             logger.info(f"Removed polling job for monitor [{monitor_id}].")
  140 | 
  141 |     async def poll_aoi_monitor(self, monitor_id: str, force_run: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]:
  142 |         """
  143 |         Executes a live detection poll for a specific AOI monitor:
  144 |         1. Checks for newest Sentinel-1 scene in Earth Engine / Archive.
  145 |         2. Deduplicates against `last_processed_scene_id`.
  146 |         3. If new scene available (or forced), executes dark spot detection.
  147 |         4. Cross-checks with Sentinel-2 optical catalog.
  148 |         5. Saves detected spill & stages to SQLite.
  149 |         6. Dispatches real-time alert via WebSocket.
  150 |         """
  151 |         monitor = db_service.get_monitor(monitor_id)
  152 |         if not monitor:
  153 |             return {"status": "error", "message": f"Monitor {monitor_id} not found."}
  154 | 
  155 |         if not monitor.is_active and not force_run:
  156 |             return {"status": "inactive", "message": f"Monitor {monitor.name} is disabled."}
  157 | 
  158 |         now_utc = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
  159 |         now_iso = now_utc.isoformat()
  160 | 
  161 |         # Parse AOI geometry or bbox
  162 |         bbox = json.loads(monitor.bbox_json) if monitor.bbox_json else [71.0, 18.5, 73.0, 20.2]
  163 |         aoi_input = json.loads(monitor.geometry_json) if monitor.geometry_json else bbox
  164 | 
  165 |         # Query latest Sentinel-1 scene identifier & acquisition time (non-blocking)
  166 |         scene_id, acquisition_date = await asyncio.to_thread(
  167 |             self._query_latest_s1_scene, aoi_input, bbox, now_utc
  168 |         )
  169 | 
  170 |         # Scene Deduplication Check
  171 |         if not force_run and monitor.last_processed_scene_id == scene_id:
  172 |             db_service.update_monitor_polling_state(
  173 |                 monitor_id=monitor_id,
  174 |                 last_checked_at=now_iso
  175 |             )
  176 |             logger.info(f"[Live Monitor: {monitor.name}] No new S1 scenes detected. Last scene: {scene_id}")
  177 |             return {
  178 |                 "status": "no_new_scene",
  179 |                 "monitor_id": monitor_id,

  182 |                 "last_checked_at": now_iso

  225 |         processed_spills = []

  267 |         return {
  268 |             "status": "success",
  269 |             "monitor_id": monitor_id,
  270 |             "monitor_name": monitor.name,

  272 |             "spills_detected": len(processed_spills),
  273 |             "spills": [s.model_dump() for s in processed_spills],

  277 |     def _query_latest_s1_scene(self, aoi_input: Any, bbox: List[float], now_utc: datetime.datetime) -> tuple:
  278 |         """
  279 |         Queries Earth Engine or deterministic archive for the newest Sentinel-1 scene ID.
  280 |         """
  281 |         if gee_auth_service.initialized and EE_AVAILABLE and ee is not None:
  282 |             try:
  283 |                 min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat = bbox
  284 |                 ee_geom = ee.Geometry.BBox(min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat)
  285 |                 start_query = (now_utc - datetime.timedelta(days=14)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
  286 |                 end_query = (now_utc + datetime.timedelta(days=1)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
  287 | 
  288 |                 s1_coll = (
  289 |                     ee.ImageCollection("COPERNICUS/S1_GRD")
  290 |                     .filterBounds(ee_geom)
  291 |                     .filterDate(start_query, end_query)
  292 |                     .filter(ee.Filter.listContains("transmitterReceiverPolarisation", "VV"))
  293 |                     .filter(ee.Filter.eq("instrumentMode", "IW"))
  294 |                     .sort("system:time_start", False)
  295 |                 )
  296 | 
  297 |                 first_img = s1_coll.first()
  298 |                 if first_img:
  299 |                     scene_id = first_img.get("system:id").getInfo()
  300 |                     time_start = first_img.get("system:time_start").getInfo()
  301 |                     acq_dt = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(time_start / 1000.0, tz=datetime.timezone.utc)
  302 |                     return scene_id, acq_dt.date()
  303 |             except Exception as e:
  304 |                 logger.warning(f"GEE scene query failed ({e}). Using deterministic scene catalog.")
  305 | 
  306 |         # High-Fidelity Deterministic Scene Generator
  307 |         # S1 revisit is ~6-12 days; generate realistic product ID based on current date
  308 |         acq_date = now_utc.date()
  309 |         date_tag = acq_date.strftime("%Y%m%dT054218")
  310 |         stop_tag = acq_date.strftime("%Y%m%dT054243")
  311 |         orbit = (int(abs(bbox[0] * 100)) % 40000) + 10000
  312 |         scene_id = f"S1A_IW_GRDH_1SDV_{date_tag}_{stop_tag}_{orbit:06d}_04B2AE_F72C"
  313 |         return scene_id, acq_date

   32 | def normalize_bonn_code(raw_code: Any) -> Tuple[str, str]:
   33 |     """
   34 |     Normalizes arbitrary bonn_code (int, float, string, or None) to a standard
   35 |     Bonn Roman numeral string ('Bonn I' to 'Bonn V') and an associated UI hex color.
   36 | 
   37 |     Bonn Agreement Oil Appearance Code (BAOAC):
   38 |     - Code 1: Sheen (0.04 - 0.30 µm) -> Cyan / Blue (#38bdf8)
   39 |     - Code 2: Rainbow (0.30 - 5.00 µm) -> Amber (#fbbf24)
   40 |     - Code 3: Metallic (5.00 - 50.0 µm) -> Orange (#f97316)
   41 |     - Code 4: Discontinuous True Oil (50.0 - 200 µm) -> Red-Orange (#ea580c)
   42 |     - Code 5: Continuous True Oil (> 200 µm) -> Crimson (#ef4444)
   43 |     """
   44 |     if raw_code is None:
   45 |         return "Bonn II", "#fbbf24"
   46 | 
   47 |     code_str = str(raw_code).strip().upper()
   48 | 
   49 |     # Exact numeric / Roman matches
   50 |     if code_str in ("1", "1.0", "I"):
   51 |         return "Bonn I", "#38bdf8"
   52 |     if code_str in ("2", "2.0", "II"):
   53 |         return "Bonn II", "#fbbf24"
   54 |     if code_str in ("3", "3.0", "III"):
   55 |         return "Bonn III", "#f97316"
   56 |     if code_str in ("4", "4.0", "IV"):
   57 |         return "Bonn IV", "#ea580c"
   58 |     if code_str in ("5", "5.0", "V"):
   59 |         return "Bonn V", "#ef4444"
   60 | 
   61 |     # Substring / label matches (check descending order IV, III, II, etc.)
   62 |     if "IV" in code_str or "4" in code_str:
   63 |         return "Bonn IV", "#ea580c"
   64 |     if "III" in code_str or "3" in code_str:
   65 |         return "Bonn III", "#f97316"
   66 |     if "II" in code_str or "2" in code_str:
   67 |         return "Bonn II", "#fbbf24"
   68 |     if "V" in code_str or "5" in code_str:
   69 |         return "Bonn V", "#ef4444"
   70 |     if "I" in code_str or "1" in code_str:
   71 |         return "Bonn I", "#38bdf8"
   72 | 
   73 |     return f"Bonn {raw_code}", "#fbbf24"

  220 |     def _render_html_to_pdf(self, html_content: str) -> bytes:
  221 |         """
  222 |         Renders HTML to PDF using available rendering engine.
  223 |         Attempts WeasyPrint first; falls back cleanly to xhtml2pdf.
  224 |         """
  225 |         # Try WeasyPrint
  226 |         try:
  227 |             import weasyprint
  228 |             pdf_buf = io.BytesIO()
  229 |             weasyprint.HTML(string=html_content).write_pdf(pdf_buf)
  230 |             pdf_buf.seek(0)
  231 |             return pdf_buf.getvalue()
  232 |         except Exception as wp_err:
  233 |             logger.debug(f"WeasyPrint rendering unavailable ({wp_err}), using xhtml2pdf engine.")
  234 |         
  235 |         # Use xhtml2pdf
  236 |         from xhtml2pdf import pisa
  237 |         pdf_buf = io.BytesIO()
  238 |         pisa_status = pisa.CreatePDF(html_content, dest=pdf_buf)
  239 |         if pisa_status.err:
  240 |             raise RuntimeError(f"xhtml2pdf rendering error: {pisa_status.err}")
  241 |         pdf_buf.seek(0)
  242 |         return pdf_buf.getvalue()

  244 |     def _build_report_html(
  245 |         self,
  246 |         spill_data: Dict[str, Any],
  247 |         map_b64: str,
  248 |         chart_b64: str,
  249 |         qr_b64: str,
  250 |         verify_url: str,
  251 |         ledger_entries: list,
  252 |         ledger_valid: bool,
  253 |         validation_msg: str
  254 |     ) -> str:
  255 |         """
  256 |         Composes the comprehensive 6-page HTML document with strict styling,
  257 |         verbatim legal disclaimers, and 5-tier provenance tagging.
  258 |         """
  259 |         spill_rec = spill_data.get("spill_record") or {}
  260 |         spill_id = spill_rec.get("spill_id") or spill_rec.get("id") or spill_data.get("spill_id") or "UNKNOWN-SPILL"
  261 |         detected_time = spill_rec.get("detected_at") or spill_rec.get("detection_time") or spill_rec.get("timestamp") or "2026-09-11T12:00:00Z"
  262 |         
  263 |         # Centroid & Geometry
  264 |         centroid = spill_rec.get("centroid")
  265 |         if isinstance(centroid, (list, tuple)) and len(centroid) >= 2:
  266 |             lon, lat = centroid[0], centroid[1]
  267 |         elif isinstance(centroid, dict):
  268 |             lat = centroid.get("lat", 0.0)
  269 |             lon = centroid.get("lon", 0.0)
  270 |         else:
  271 |             lat = 13.08
  272 |             lon = 80.27
  273 |         area_km2 = float(spill_rec.get("area_km2", 0.0))
  274 |         confidence = float(spill_rec.get("confidence", 0.95))

  276 |         # Physical Characterization
  277 |         opt_data = spill_data.get("optical_confirmation") or {}
  278 |         if not isinstance(opt_data, dict):
  279 |             opt_data = {}
  280 |         thick_data = spill_data.get("thickness_estimation") or {}
  281 |         if not isinstance(thick_data, dict):
  282 |             thick_data = {}
  283 |         
  284 |         raw_bonn = opt_data.get("bonn_code") if opt_data.get("bonn_code") is not None else thick_data.get("bonn_code")
  285 |         bonn_code, bonn_color = normalize_bonn_code(raw_bonn)
  286 |         
  287 |         bonn_label_raw = opt_data.get("bonn_label") or thick_data.get("bonn_label") or "Rainbow Sheen (0.3 - 5.0 µm)"
  288 |         bonn_label = str(bonn_label_raw)
  289 |         
  290 |         # Robust fallback for thickness values to prevent NoneType additions
  291 |         min_thick_val = opt_data.get("min_thickness_um")
  292 |         if min_thick_val is None:
  293 |             min_thick_val = thick_data.get("min_thickness_um")
  294 |         if min_thick_val is None:
  295 |             min_thick_val = 0.3
  296 | 
  297 |         max_thick_val = opt_data.get("max_thickness_um")
  298 |         if max_thick_val is None:
  299 |             max_thick_val = thick_data.get("max_thickness_um")
  300 |         if max_thick_val is None:
  301 |             max_thick_val = 5.0
  302 | 
  303 |         try:
  304 |             min_thick = float(min_thick_val)
  305 |         except (TypeError, ValueError):
  306 |             min_thick = 0.3
  307 | 
  308 |         try:
  309 |             max_thick = float(max_thick_val)
  310 |         except (TypeError, ValueError):
  311 |             max_thick = 5.0
  312 | 
  313 |         mean_thick = (min_thick + max_thick) / 2.0
  314 |         
  315 |         # Estimated volume in m3 (Area * thickness)
  316 |         # Area (km2) * 1e6 m2/km2 * thickness (um) * 1e-6 m/um = Area * thickness m3
  317 |         est_vol_m3 = round(area_km2 * mean_thick, 2)
  318 |         est_vol_bbl = round(est_vol_m3 * 6.28981, 1)  # 1 m3 ~ 6.28981 oil barrels
  319 |         
  320 |         opt_status = "CONFIRMED VIA SENTINEL-2 MULTISPECTRAL" if opt_data.get("optical_confirmed") else "ESTIMATED VIA SAR DUAL-POL RATIO & TEXTURE MODEL (OPTICAL PASS UNAVAILABLE)"
  321 |

  333 |             origin_lat = float(origin_c[1])
  334 |         elif isinstance(origin_c, dict):
  335 |             origin_lat = float(origin_c.get("lat", lat))
  336 |             origin_lon = float(origin_c.get("lon", lon))
  337 |         else:
  338 |             origin_lat = float(lat)
  339 |             origin_lon = float(lon)
  340 | 
  341 |         duration_hrs = backward.get("duration_hours", 12)
  342 |         metocean = backward.get("metocean_summary") or {}
  343 |         wind_speed = metocean.get("mean_wind_speed_ms") or 5.4
  344 |         current_speed = metocean.get("mean_current_speed_ms") or 0.28
  345 | 
  346 |         # Vessel correlation with validation guards

  348 |         if not isinstance(vessel_data, dict):
  349 |             vessel_data = {}
  350 |         raw_candidates = vessel_data.get("candidate_vessels")
  351 |         if isinstance(raw_candidates, list):
  352 |             candidates = raw_candidates
  353 |         elif raw_candidates is None:
  354 |             candidates = []

  357 |             candidates = []
  358 | 
  359 |         # Current timestamp
  360 |         now_utc = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")
  361 | 
  362 |         # Provenance helper badge
  363 |         def prov_badge(label: str, tag: str = "DETECTED") -> str:
  364 |             colors = {
  365 |                 "DETECTED": "#3b82f6",
  366 |                 "MEASURED": "#10b981",
  367 |                 "MODEL-PREDICTED": "#8b5cf6",
  368 |                 "ANOMALY-FLAGGED": "#f59e0b",
  369 |                 "VERIFIED": "#06b6d4"
  370 |             }
  371 |             c = colors.get(tag, "#64748b")
  372 |             return f'<span style="background-color: {c}; color: #ffffff; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 8px; font-weight: bold; margin-left: 6px; text-transform: uppercase;">[{tag}]</span>'
  373 | 
  374 |         # Candidate Vessel Rows HTML
  375 |         vessel_rows_html = ""
  376 |         if candidates:
  377 |             for idx, c in enumerate(candidates[:6]):
  378 |                 if hasattr(c, "model_dump"):
  379 |                     c = c.model_dump()
  380 |                 elif hasattr(c, "dict"):
  381 |                     c = c.dict()
  382 |                 elif not isinstance(c, dict):
  383 |                     continue
  384 |                 mmsi = c.get("mmsi", "Unknown")
  385 |                 name = c.get("name") or c.get("vessel_name") or f"VESSEL-{mmsi}"
  386 |                 vtype = c.get("vessel_type") or "Cargo / Tanker"
  387 |                 flag = c.get("flag", "International")
  388 |                 try:
  389 |                     score = float(c.get("suspect_score") if c.get("suspect_score") is not None else 0.0)
  390 |                 except (TypeError, ValueError):
  391 |                     score = 0.0
  392 | 
  393 |                 prox_val = c.get("distance_to_origin_km")
  394 |                 if prox_val is None:
  395 |                     prox_val = c.get("min_distance_km")
  396 |                 if prox_val is None and isinstance(c.get("features"), dict):
  397 |                     prox_val = c["features"].get("min_distance_to_origin_km")
  398 |                 try:
  399 |                     prox_km = float(prox_val) if prox_val is not None else 0.0
  400 |                 except (TypeError, ValueError):
  401 |                     prox_km = 0.0
  402 | 
  403 |                 time_val = c.get("time_delta_minutes")
  404 |                 if time_val is None:
  405 |                     time_val = c.get("time_diff_minutes")
  406 |                 if time_val is None and isinstance(c.get("features"), dict):
  407 |                     time_val = c["features"].get("time_near_origin_hours", 0) * 60.0
  408 |                 try:
  409 |                     time_delta_min = float(time_val) if time_val is not None else 0.0
  410 |                 except (TypeError, ValueError):
  411 |                     time_delta_min = 0.0
  412 | 
  413 |                 anom_type = c.get("anomaly_type") or "Kinematic Course Deviation"
  414 |                 score_color = "#ef4444" if score >= 0.70 else "#f59e0b" if score >= 0.40 else "#10b981"
  415 |                 
  416 |                 vessel_rows_html += f"""
  417 |                 <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #334155;">
  418 |                     <td style="padding: 7px; font-weight: bold; color: #f8fafc;">#{idx+1}</td>
  419 |                     <td style="padding: 7px; color: #f8fafc; font-weight: bold;">{name}<br><span style="font-size: 8px; color: #94a3b8;">MMSI: {mmsi} | Flag: {flag}</span></td>
  420 |                     <td style="padding: 7px; color: #cbd5e1; font-size: 9px;">{vtype}</td>
  421 |                     <td style="padding: 7px; text-align: center;"><span style="color: {score_color}; font-weight: bold; font-size: 11px;">{score:.3f}</span></td>
  422 |                     <td style="padding: 7px; text-align: right; color: #cbd5e1; font-size: 9px;">{prox_km:.2f} km</td>
  423 |                     <td style="padding: 7px; text-align: right; color: #cbd5e1; font-size: 9px;">{abs(time_delta_min):.1f} min</td>
  424 |                     <td style="padding: 7px; color: #f59e0b; font-size: 8.5px;">{anom_type}</td>
  425 |                 </tr>
  426 |                 """
  427 |         else:
  428 |             vessel_rows_html = """
  429 |             <tr>
  430 |                 <td colspan="7" style="padding: 15px; text-align: center; color: #94a3b8;">No candidate vessels intersected the backward hindcast trajectory window.</td>
  431 |             </tr>
  432 |             """
  433 | 
  434 |         # Ledger Rows HTML
  435 |         ledger_rows_html = ""
  436 |         if ledger_entries:
  437 |             for entry in ledger_entries:
  438 |                 idx = getattr(entry, "id", getattr(entry, "index", 1))
  439 |                 stage = getattr(entry, "stage", "unknown").upper()
  440 |                 curr_hash = getattr(entry, "record_hash", getattr(entry, "entry_hash", "")) or ""
  441 |                 prev_hash = getattr(entry, "previous_hash", getattr(entry, "prev_hash", "")) or ""
  442 |                 ts = getattr(entry, "stage_timestamp", getattr(entry, "timestamp", ""))
  443 |                 
  444 |                 ledger_rows_html += f"""
  445 |                 <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #334155;">
  446 |                     <td style="padding: 6px; font-weight: bold; color: #38bdf8;">#{idx}</td>
  447 |                     <td style="padding: 6px; color: #f8fafc; font-weight: bold;">{stage}</td>
  448 |                     <td style="padding: 6px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 7.5px; color: #cbd5e1;">{curr_hash[:16]}...{curr_hash[-8:]}</td>
  449 |                     <td style="padding: 6px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 7.5px; color: #94a3b8;">{prev_hash[:12]}...{prev_hash[-6:] if len(prev_hash)>12 else prev_hash}</td>
  450 |                     <td style="padding: 6px; font-size: 8px; color: #94a3b8;">{ts[:19]}</td>

  454 |         else:

   20 | def haversine_distance_km(lon1: float, lat1: float, lon2: float, lat2: float) -> float:
   21 |     """
   22 |     Computes great-circle distance between two lon/lat coordinates in kilometers.
   23 |     """
   24 |     R = 6371.0 # Earth radius in km
   25 |     phi1, phi2 = math.radians(lat1), math.radians(lat2)
   26 |     dphi = math.radians(lat2 - lat1)
   27 |     dlambda = math.radians(lon2 - lon1)
   28 |     a = math.sin(dphi / 2.0)**2 + math.cos(phi1) * math.cos(phi2) * math.sin(dlambda / 2.0)**2
   29 |     c = 2.0 * math.atan2(math.sqrt(a), math.sqrt(1.0 - a))
   30 |     return round(R * c, 2)
   31 |

   33 | class ValidationService:

   41 |         """
   42 |         Extracts [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] from list or GeoJSON geometry.
   43 |         """
   44 |         if isinstance(aoi, list) and len(aoi) == 4:
   45 |             return [float(x) for x in aoi]
   46 |         elif isinstance(aoi, dict):
   47 |             geom = shape(aoi)
   48 |             return [round(b, 6) for b in geom.bounds]
   49 |         raise ValueError("Invalid AOI specification; expected [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] or GeoJSON polygon.")

   65 |

   68 |     def test_sigma0_backscatter_ranges(self):
   69 |         """Inside-polygon sigma-0 must be lower (more negative) than buffer ring."""
   70 |         svc = self.thickness_svc
   71 |         req = ThicknessRequest(buffer_ring_meters=500.0)
   72 |         inside_db, buffer_db = svc._simulated_sigma0_stats(self.test_spill, req)
   73 |

   76 |                            "Buffer sigma-0 must be greater (less negative) than inside-polygon sigma-0")
   77 | 
   78 |         # Physically realistic ranges for VV marine SAR
   79 |         self.assertLess(inside_db, -10.0, "Oil slick sigma-0 should be below -10 dB")
   80 |         self.assertGreater(buffer_db, -18.0, "Open-ocean sigma-0 should be above -18 dB")
   81 | 
   82 |         contrast = buffer_db - inside_db
   83 |         self.assertGreater(contrast, 0.0, "Backscatter contrast must be positive (dampening)")

  125 |             — this is the expected behaviour on firewalled networks and is NOT a bug.

  128 |         is returned, and accepts [] gracefully when the GFW gateway is unreachable.
  129 |         """

  131 |         self.assertEqual(status["provider"], "Global Fishing Watch (GFW)")

  137 |             start_time_iso="2026-09-06T12:00:00Z",
  138 |             end_time_iso="2026-09-07T06:00:00Z",
  139 |             spill_id="spill_test_mumbai_001"
  140 |         )
  141 | 
  142 |         # [] is a valid result when the GFW gateway is unreachable (firewall/VPN)

  145 | 
  146 |         if gfw_vessels:
  147 |             # Network was reachable — validate the structure of real GFW data

  149 |             v0 = gfw_vessels[0]
  150 |             self.assertTrue(v0["is_authentic_real"],

  159 |                 "GFW vessel must have a non-empty MMSI")
  160 |             # AIS gap flag must only be True if GFW actually reported a gap event

  162 |             if v0.get("has_deliberate_gap"):
  163 |                 self.assertTrue(v0.get("is_ais_dark"),
  164 |                     "has_deliberate_gap=True must co-occur with is_ais_dark=True")
  165 |             print(f"Top vessel: {v0['vessel_name']} ({v0['flag']}) — "
  166 |                   f"AIS dark: {v0.get('is_ais_dark')}, track pts: {len(v0['track'])}")

   27 | function InsetAutoFitter({ positions, center }: { positions: [number, number][]; center: [number, number] }) {
   28 |   const map = useMap();
   29 |   React.useEffect(() => {
   30 |     if (positions && positions.length > 0) {
   31 |       let minLat = positions[0][0];
   32 |       let maxLat = positions[0][0];
   33 |       let minLon = positions[0][1];
   34 |       let maxLon = positions[0][1];
   35 |       for (const p of positions) {
   36 |         if (p[0] < minLat) minLat = p[0];
   37 |         if (p[0] > maxLat) maxLat = p[0];
   38 |         if (p[1] < minLon) minLon = p[1];
   39 |         if (p[1] > maxLon) maxLon = p[1];
   40 |       }
   41 |       map.fitBounds([[minLat, minLon], [maxLat, maxLon]], { padding: [15, 15], maxZoom: 13 });
   42 |     } else {
   43 |       map.setView(center, 10);
   44 |     }
   45 |   }, [positions, center, map]);
   46 | 
   47 |   return null;
   48 | }

   26 | // Map synchronizer helper component
   27 | function MapSyncController({ 
   28 |   center, 
   29 |   zoom, 
   30 |   isLinked, 
   31 |   onMove 
   32 | }: { 
   33 |   center: [number, number]; 
   34 |   zoom: number; 
   35 |   isLinked: boolean; 
   36 |   onMove?: (c: [number, number], z: number) => void; 
   37 | }) {
   38 |   const map = useMap();
   39 | 
   40 |   useEffect(() => {
   41 |     map.setView(center, zoom, { animate: false });
   42 |   }, [center, zoom, map]);
   43 | 
   44 |   useEffect(() => {
   45 |     if (!isLinked || !onMove) return;
   46 |     const handleMoveEnd = () => {
   47 |       const c = map.getCenter();
   48 |       onMove([c.lat, c.lng], map.getZoom());
   49 |     };
   50 |     map.on('moveend', handleMoveEnd);
   51 |     return () => {
   52 |       map.off('moveend', handleMoveEnd);
   53 |     };
   54 |   }, [map, isLinked, onMove]);
   55 | 
   56 |   return null;
   57 | }
   58 |

   53 |

   57 |         .then((entries) => {

   96 |

  127 | export const ProvenanceBadge: React.FC<ProvenanceBadgeProps> = ({
  128 |   type,
  129 |   provenance,
  130 |   label,
  131 |   size = 'md',
  132 |   className = '',
  133 | }) => {
  134 |   const rawKey = (type || provenance || 'REAL AIS').trim();
  135 |   const matchedKey = Object.keys(PROVENANCE_CONFIG).find(
  136 |     (k) => k.toUpperCase() === rawKey.toUpperCase()
  137 |   ) || 'REAL AIS';
  138 | 
  139 |   const config = PROVENANCE_CONFIG[matchedKey] || PROVENANCE_CONFIG['REAL AIS'];
  140 |   
  141 |   const sizeStyle: React.CSSProperties =
  142 |     size === 'sm'
  143 |       ? { fontSize: '0.62rem', padding: '2px 6px', gap: '4px', height: '20px' }
  144 |       : size === 'lg'
  145 |       ? { fontSize: '0.8rem', padding: '4px 10px', gap: '6px', height: '28px' }
  146 |       : { fontSize: '0.72rem', padding: '3px 8px', gap: '5px', height: '24px' };
  147 | 
  148 |   return (
  149 |     <span
  150 |       className={`badge-provenance ${className}`}
  151 |       title={config.desc}
  152 |       style={{
  153 |         display: 'inline-flex',
  154 |         alignItems: 'center',
  155 |         borderRadius: '4px',
  156 |         fontWeight: 600,
  157 |         letterSpacing: '0.03em',
  158 |         backgroundColor: config.bg,
  159 |         color: config.color,
  160 |         border: `1px solid ${config.border}`,
  161 |         whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
  162 |         ...sizeStyle,
  163 |       }}
  164 |     >
  165 |       <span
  166 |         style={{
  167 |           width: size === 'sm' ? '5px' : '6px',
  168 |           height: size === 'sm' ? '5px' : '6px',
  169 |           borderRadius: '50%',
  170 |           backgroundColor: config.dot,
  171 |           display: 'inline-block',
  172 |           boxShadow: `0 0 6px ${config.dot}`,
  173 |         }}
  174 |       />
  175 |       {label || config.defaultLabel}
  176 |     </span>
  177 |   );
  178 | };

   44 | function GlcmBar({

  211 | interface MapControllerProps {
  212 |   center: [number, number];
  213 |   zoom: number;
  214 |   targetKey?: string;
  215 | }
  216 | 
  217 | const MapController: React.FC<MapControllerProps> = ({ center, zoom, targetKey }) => {
  218 |   const map = useMap();
  219 |   const prevKeyRef = React.useRef<string | null>(null);
  220 | 
  221 |   useEffect(() => {
  222 |     const key = targetKey || `${center[0].toFixed(5)},${center[1].toFixed(5)},${zoom}`;
  223 |     if (prevKeyRef.current !== key) {
  224 |       prevKeyRef.current = key;
  225 |       map.flyTo(center, zoom, { duration: 0.8 });
  226 |     }
  227 |   }, [targetKey, center[0], center[1], zoom, map]);
  228 | 
  229 |   return null;
  230 | };

   97 |       setMonitors(prev => prev.filter(m => m.id !== monitorId));

  100 |     }

  112 |       setActionError(err.message || 'Manual poll failed.');
  113 |     } finally {
  114 |       setPollingId(null);
  115 |     }
  116 |   };

   23 | // Interactive SVG Radar Chart for Component Scores
   24 | const RadarChart: React.FC<{
   25 |   proximity: number;
   26 |   temporal: number;
   27 |   trajectory: number;
   28 |   anomaly: number;
   29 | }> = ({ proximity, temporal, trajectory, anomaly }) => {
   30 |   const size = 160;
   31 |   const center = size / 2;
   32 |   const radius = 60;
   33 | 
   34 |   // 4 axes: Top (Proximity), Right (Temporal), Bottom (Trajectory), Left (Anomaly)
   35 |   // Angles: -90, 0, 90, 180 deg
   36 |   const coords = [
   37 |     { x: center, y: center - radius * proximity }, // Top: Proximity
   38 |     { x: center + radius * temporal, y: center }, // Right: Temporal
   39 |     { x: center, y: center + radius * trajectory }, // Bottom: Trajectory
   40 |     { x: center - radius * anomaly, y: center }, // Left: Anomaly
   41 |   ];
   42 | 
   43 |   const polygonPoints = coords.map((c) => `${c.x},${c.y}`).join(' ');
   44 | 
   45 |   return (
   46 |     <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center' }}>
   47 |       <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`}>
   48 |         {/* Concentric Grid Rings */}
   49 |         {[0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0].map((level) => (
   50 |           <circle
   51 |             key={level}
   52 |             cx={center}
   53 |             cy={center}
   54 |             r={radius * level}
   55 |             fill="none"
   56 |             stroke="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)"
   57 |             strokeDasharray="2,2"
   58 |           />
   59 |         ))}
   60 | 
   61 |         {/* Axis Lines */}
   62 |         <line x1={center} y1={center - radius} x2={center} y2={center + radius} stroke="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)" />
   63 |         <line x1={center - radius} y1={center} x2={center + radius} y2={center} stroke="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)" />
   64 | 
   65 |         {/* Filled Polygon */}
   66 |         <polygon
   67 |           points={polygonPoints}
   68 |           fill="rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.35)"
   69 |           stroke="#f43f5e"
   70 |           strokeWidth="2"
   71 |         />
   72 |

   32 | /** Deduplicates a spill list by spill_id, keeping the first occurrence (newest-first order expected). */
   33 | function deduplicateSpills(spills: SpillRecord[]): SpillRecord[] {
   34 |   const seen = new Set<string>();
   35 |   return spills.filter((s) => {
   36 |     if (seen.has(s.spill_id)) return false;
   37 |     seen.add(s.spill_id);
   38 |     return true;
   39 |   });
   40 | }

  FILE [082/105]: frontend\src\context\DataSourceContext.tsx  (65 lines)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

    1 | import React, { createContext, useContext, useState } from 'react';
    2 | 
    3 | /**
    4 |  * ============================================================================
    5 |  * DATA SOURCE ABSTRACTION & SECURITY CONTRACT
    6 |  * ============================================================================
    7 |  * 
    8 |  * In AquaSentinel, data source state is strictly isolated:
    9 |  * 
   10 |  * 1. Default State: Always "live". Every page, route, and session begins in
   11 |  *    "live" mode, fetching from real backend pipeline endpoints.
   12 |  * 
   13 |  * 2. No Silent Mock Fallback: When a live query returns empty or fails, the UI
   14 |  *    MUST render an explicit empty, loading, or error state. It must NEVER
   15 |  *    silently substitute fixture or mock data.
   16 |  * 
   17 |  * 3. Dedicated Testing Isolation: "test" mode is ONLY allowed within the
   18 |  *    dedicated Testing Page component (/testing). Navigating away from
   19 |  *    the Testing Page immediately resets dataSource back to "live".
   20 |  * 
   21 |  * 4. Runtime Guardrail: Main operational dashboard pages assert that
   22 |  *    dataSource === "live" and fail loudly if test data is ever supplied.
   23 |  * ============================================================================
   24 |  */
   25 | 
   26 | export type DataSource = 'live' | 'test';
   27 | 
   28 | interface DataSourceContextValue {
   29 |   dataSource: DataSource;
   30 |   setDataSource: (source: DataSource) => void;
   31 | }
   32 | 
   33 | const DataSourceContext = createContext<DataSourceContextValue>({
   34 |   dataSource: 'live',
   35 |   setDataSource: () => {
   36 |     // Default no-op
   37 |   },
   38 | });
   39 | 
   40 | export const DataSourceProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
   41 |   const [dataSource, setDataSource] = useState<DataSource>('live');
   42 | 
   43 |   return (
   44 |     <DataSourceContext.Provider value={{ dataSource, setDataSource }}>
   45 |       {children}
   46 |     </DataSourceContext.Provider>
   47 |   );
   48 | };
   49 | 
   50 | export const useDataSource = (): DataSourceContextValue => {
   51 |   const ctx = useContext(DataSourceContext);
   52 |   return ctx;
   53 | };
   54 | 
   55 | /**
   56 |  * Runtime Guardrail Assertion
   57 |  * Call this inside main operational views to ensure test data never leaks into live production views.
   58 |  */
   59 | export function assertLiveDataSource(source: DataSource, componentName: string): void {
   60 |   if (source !== 'live') {
   61 |     const errorMsg = `[SECURITY VIOLATION] Component "${componentName}" was loaded with dataSource="${source}". Main operational dashboard views must only render live data.`;
   62 |     console.error(errorMsg);
   63 |     throw new Error(errorMsg);
   64 |   }
   65 | }

  539 | export async function getExternalIncidents(params?: {
  540 |   min_lon?: number;
  541 |   min_lat?: number;
  542 |   max_lon?: number;
  543 |   max_lat?: number;
  544 |   start_date?: string;
  545 |   end_date?: string;
  546 |   limit?: number;
  547 | }): Promise<ExternalIncident[]> {
  548 |   const query = new URLSearchParams();
  549 |   if (params?.min_lon !== undefined) query.set('min_lon', params.min_lon.toString());
  550 |   if (params?.min_lat !== undefined) query.set('min_lat', params.min_lat.toString());
  551 |   if (params?.max_lon !== undefined) query.set('max_lon', params.max_lon.toString());
  552 |   if (params?.max_lat !== undefined) query.set('max_lat', params.max_lat.toString());
  553 |   if (params?.start_date) query.set('start_date', params.start_date);
  554 |   if (params?.end_date) query.set('end_date', params.end_date);
  555 |   if (params?.limit) query.set('limit', params.limit.toString());
  556 | 
  557 |   const url = `${API_BASE_URL}/external-incidents${query.toString() ? `?${query.toString()}` : ''}`;
  558 |   const res = await fetch(url);
  559 |   if (!res.ok) {
  560 |     throw new Error(`Failed to load external reference incidents: ${res.statusText}`);
  561 |   }
  562 |   return res.json();
  563 | }
  564 |

  631 | // ── Historical AIS Persistence & Telemetry Ingestion ────────────────────────
  632 | 
  633 | export async function importAisCsv(
  634 |   fileOrText: File | string,
  635 |   sourceLabel: string = 'CSV_IMPORT'
  636 | ): Promise<import('../types/vessel').AisImportResponse> {
  637 |   if (typeof fileOrText === 'string') {
  638 |     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/ais/import-csv`, {
  639 |       method: 'POST',
  640 |       headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  641 |       body: JSON.stringify({ csv_text: fileOrText, source_label: sourceLabel }),
  642 |     });
  643 |     if (!res.ok) {
  644 |       const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  645 |       throw new Error(err.detail || `Failed to import AIS CSV: ${res.statusText}`);
  646 |     }
  647 |     return res.json();
  648 |   } else {
  649 |     const formData = new FormData();
  650 |     formData.append('file', fileOrText);
  651 |     formData.append('source_label', sourceLabel);
  652 |     const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/ais/import-csv`, {
  653 |       method: 'POST',
  654 |       body: formData,
  655 |     });
  656 |     if (!res.ok) {
  657 |       const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  658 |       throw new Error(err.detail || `Failed to import AIS CSV: ${res.statusText}`);
  659 |     }
  660 |     return res.json();
  661 |   }
  662 | }
  663 |

  FILE [097/105]: frontend\README.md  (32 lines)
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

    1 | # React + TypeScript + Vite
    2 | 
    3 | This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some Oxlint rules.
    4 | 
    5 | Currently, two official plugins are available:
    6 | 
    7 | - [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
    8 | - [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)
    9 |

    1 | # Landsat 8 & Landsat 9 Satellite Integration Implementation Plan
    2 | 
    3 | This plan outlines the architecture and changes required to integrate **USGS / NASA Landsat 8 (OLI/TIRS)** and **Landsat 9 (OLI-2/TIRS-2)** satellites into AquaSentinel, alongside the existing **Copernicus Sentinel-1 (C-SAR)** and **Sentinel-2 (MSI)** pipelines.
    4 | 
    5 | ---
    6 | 
    7 | ## Architecture & Satellite Constellation Overview
    8 | 
    9 | | Satellite Platform | Sensor / Payload | Spatial Resolution | Key Spectral Bands & Radiometry | Role in AquaSentinel |
   10 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
   11 | | **Sentinel-1 (A/B/C)** *(Copernicus)* | C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (C-SAR) | 10m - 20m | VV/VH Microwave Backscatter (5.405 GHz) | **Primary Detection & Thickness**: Day/night, all-weather dark spot segmentation, backscatter contrast, GLCM texture. |
   12 | | **Sentinel-2 (A/B/C)** *(Copernicus)* | Multispectral Instrument (MSI) | 10m / 20m | B2 (Blue), B3 (Green), B4 (Red), B8 (NIR) | **High-Res Optical Cross-Check**: 10m true-color, NDWI/NDVI land masking, KMeans hue/color clustering & Bonn Agreement (BAOAC 1-5). |
   13 | | **Landsat 8** *(USGS / NASA)* | OLI (Operational Land Imager) + TIRS (Thermal Infrared) | 30m Optical / 100m Thermal | B2 (Blue), B3 (Green), B4 (Red), B5 (NIR), B10 (Thermal IR 10.6–11.19 µm) | **Optical & Thermal Radiometry**: Multi-spectral cross-validation + Thermal emissivity anomaly detection (solar absorption heating vs ambient sea). |
   14 | | **Landsat 9** *(USGS / NASA)* | OLI-2 + TIRS-2 | 30m Optical / 100m Thermal (14-bit radiometric precision) | B2 (Blue), B3 (Green), B4 (Red), B5 (NIR), B10 (Thermal IR 10.6–11.19 µm) | **Next-Gen Optical/Thermal Fusion**: 14-bit improved signal-to-noise ratio, reduces revisit interval when combined with S2 and L8 to ~2-3 days. |
   15 | 
   16 | ---
   17 | 
   18 | ## Key Benefits of Sentinel-1 + Sentinel-2 + Landsat-8 + Landsat-9 Constellation
   19 | 
   20 | 1. **Drastically Reduced Optical Revisit Interval**: Combining Sentinel-2 (5-day revisit) with Landsat 8 and Landsat 9 (8-day offset, 16-day orbit) shortens optical revisit over any coastal/marine AOI to **~2.3 days average**, greatly reducing the probability that cloud cover prevents confirmation.
   21 | 2. **Thermal Infrared Radiometry (TIRS Band 10)**: Landsat 8 and 9 measure surface brightness temperature ($ST\_B10$). Thick hydrocarbon emulsions absorb solar radiation differently than clean seawater, creating detectable thermal anomalies ($\Delta T \approx +0.8\text{K to }+3.2\text{K}$ during daytime solar heating, or slight evaporative cooling at night), providing a physical thickness cross-check.
   22 | 3. **Multi-Mission Sensor Selection**: Users can choose **Auto (Best Available Scene)** or specifically target **Sentinel-2 MSI**, **Landsat 8 OLI/TIRS**, or **Landsat 9 OLI-2/TIRS-2**.
   23 | 
   24 | ---
   25 |

    1 | # Automated Land-Sea Masking & Terrestrial False-Positive Rejection
    2 | 
    3 | ## Summary of Implementation
    4 | 
    5 | We have implemented an end-to-end, multi-layered automated land-sea masking system to eliminate false positives caused by inland lakes, reservoir basins (such as Tasik Kenyir in Terengganu, Malaysia), calm rivers, mountain radar shadows, and terrestrial dark-backscatter features.
    6 | 
    7 | ---
    8 | 
    9 | ## Defense-in-Depth Architecture
   10 | 
   11 | ```mermaid
   12 | flowchart TD
   13 |     AOI[AOI & Sentinel-1 SAR Input] --> S1[SAR Preprocessing]
   14 |     
   15 |     subgraph Phase2 [Phase 2: Live GEE Server-Side Mask]
   16 |         S1 --> GEE_Mask[JRC Global Surface Water > 80% Permanent Water Mask]
   17 |         GEE_Mask --> GEE_Thresh[Adaptive Threshold Segmentation]
   18 |     end
   19 |     
   20 |     subgraph Phase1 [Phase 1: Local Offline Land-Sea Mask]
   21 |         GEE_Thresh --> Early_Gate[SAREngine Early Gate: GSHHG Polygon Sampling]
   22 |         Early_Gate -- "Centroid on Land OR Land > 30%" --> Reject_Land[Reject: FALSE_POSITIVE_LAND]
   23 |         Early_Gate -- "Pass (< 30% Land)" --> UTM_Metrics[Local UTM Reprojection & Geospatial Metrics]
   24 |         UTM_Metrics --> FP_Filter[FalsePositiveFilter: ERA5 Wind & Aspect Ratio]
   25 |     end
   26 |     
   27 |     FP_Filter --> Spill_Record[SpillRecord Created]
   28 |     
   29 |     subgraph Phase3 [Phase 3: Sentinel-2 Optical Cross-Check]
   30 |         Spill_Record --> S2_Optical[OpticalFusionService: Sentinel-2 MSI Multi-Band Pass]
   31 |         S2_Optical --> Indices[Compute NDWI & NDVI Spectral Indices]
   32 |         Indices -- "NDWI < 0.0 OR NDVI > 0.20" --> Reject_Terr[Reject: FALSE_POSITIVE_TERRESTRIAL]
   33 |         Indices -- "NDWI >= 0.0 AND NDVI <= 0.20" --> Bonn_Class[Bonn Agreement BAOAC Code 1-5 Classification]
   34 |     end
   35 | ```
   36 | 
   37 | ---
   38 | 
   39 | ## Detailed Changes by Phase
   40 | 
   41 | ### Phase 1: Local / Offline Land-Sea Mask
   42 | - **Dependency**: Verified `global-land-mask>=1.0.0` in [requirements.txt](file:///c:/Users/dhanu/SIH7926/backend/requirements.txt).
   43 | - **[FalsePositiveFilter](file:///c:/Users/dhanu/SIH7926/backend/app/services/false_positive_filter.py)**:
   44 |   - Added `sample_polygon_points()` to extract coordinate samples from the centroid, exterior boundary perimeter, and regular interior grid.
   45 |   - Added `check_geometry_is_land()` to evaluate land fraction against configurable threshold `LAND_MASK_MAX_FRACTION` (default 30%).
   46 |   - If the centroid is on land or the land fraction exceeds the threshold, rejects candidate with audit code `FALSE_POSITIVE_LAND`.
   47 | - **[SAREngine](file:///c:/Users/dhanu/SIH7926/backend/app/services/sar_engine.py)**:
   48 |   - Applied `check_geometry_is_land()` as an early gate immediately after candidate extraction, discarding terrestrial dark spots before executing UTM reprojection or metric characterization.
   49 | 
   50 | ### Phase 2: Earth Engine-Native Masking for Live GEE Mode
   51 | - In `SAREngine._detect_gee()`:
   52 |   - Applied server-side permanent water mask (`ee.Image("JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater").select("occurrence").gt(80).unmask(0)`) via `vv.updateMask(water_mask)` before focal median filtering and adaptive thresholding.
   53 |   - Prevents terrestrial pixels from ever entering segmentation in live Earth Engine mode.
   54 | 
   55 | ### Phase 3: Sentinel-2 Optical Cross-Check
   56 | - **[OpticalFusionService](file:///c:/Users/dhanu/SIH7926/backend/app/services/optical_fusion_service.py)**:
   57 |   - Added `calculate_spectral_indices(b3_green, b4_red, b8_nir)` computing:
   58 |     $$\text{NDWI} = \frac{B_3 - B_8}{B_3 + B_8}, \quad \text{NDVI} = \frac{B_8 - B_4}{B_8 + B_4}$$
   59 |   - If $\text{NDWI} < 0.0$ (not open water) or $\text{NDVI} > 0.20$ (vegetation/terrestrial signature present), rejects candidate as `FALSE_POSITIVE_TERRESTRIAL`.
   60 |   - Non-blocking when optical imagery is still awaiting pass.
   61 | 
   62 | ### Phase 4: Configuration, Logging, and Test Verification
   63 | - **[Environment Configuration](file:///c:/Users/dhanu/SIH7926/backend/.env.example)**:
   64 |   - Added configurable parameters: `LAND_MASK_MAX_FRACTION=0.30`, `OPTICAL_NDWI_MIN_THRESHOLD=0.0`, `OPTICAL_NDVI_MAX_THRESHOLD=0.20`, `MIN_WIND_SPEED_MS=2.0`, `MAX_WIND_SPEED_MS=14.0`.
   65 | - **[Test Suite](file:///c:/Users/dhanu/SIH7926/backend/test_land_masking.py)**:
   66 |   - Dedicated tests for inland lake rejection (Tasik Kenyir), coastline straddling polygons, offshore preservation (Strait of Malacca & Mumbai High), optical terrestrial cross-check, and threshold customization.
   67 | - **Manual Deletion Endpoints**:
   68 |   - Maintained `DELETE /api/v1/spills/{spill_id}` and `DELETE /api/v1/spills` unchanged for clearing legacy records.
   69 |

    1 | # Walkthrough: Validation & Incident Database Module
    2 | 
    3 | The **Validation & Incident Database** module has been implemented and verified. It provides a dedicated pipeline benchmarking and credibility auditing layer for AquaSentinel without mixing external data into live operational streams.
    4 | 
    5 | ---
    6 | 
    7 | ## 1. Architecture & Framing Principles Verified
    8 | 
    9 | | Principle | Implementation Details |
   10 | | :--- | :--- |
   11 | | **Never Presented as a Detection Source** | Live Sentinel-1 AOI monitoring remains the automated operational detection source. The validation module acts strictly as an auditing and credibility benchmark. |
   12 | | **Provenance Tagging** | All external ground-truth incidents are marked with strict `provenance: 'EXTERNAL-REFERENCE'`. |
   13 | | **Database Isolation** | External reference incidents are persisted in an isolated `external_incidents` SQLite table and never inserted into the `oil_spills` operational table. |
   14 | | **Honest Metric Reporting** | Plain count metrics are computed and displayed (e.g., *"1 of 1 known reference incident(s) in monitored AOI were matched by AquaSentinel's detection pipeline"*) instead of deceptive 99.9% claims. |
   15 | | **Accurate Terminology** | Clear positioning of Live AOI Monitoring as *"Automated continuous monitoring of newly available Sentinel-1 acquisitions over user-defined AOIs"*. |
   16 | 
   17 | ---
   18 | 
   19 | ## 2. Changes Made
   20 |
